document.title: Rules Governing the Functions of the OIC Committee of Permanent Representatives and its Modes of Operation
document.purpose: Defines the role, responsibilities, meetings, and operational procedures of the Committee of Permanent Representatives.

Rules.meaning: Rules Governing the Functions of the OIC Committee of Permanent Representatives and its Modes of Operation

Charter.meaning: Charter of the Organization of Islamic Cooperation

Member_State.meaning: Any country that is officially a member of the OIC

General_Secretariat.meaning: Administrative body of the Organization of Islamic Cooperation

Secretary_General.meaning: Head of the OIC General Secretariat

Permanent_Representative.meaning: Official representative of an OIC Member State

membership.members: Permanent Representatives of all OIC Member States

articles.title: Definitions
articles.objective: Defines the important terms used throughout the Rules.

articles.title: Status of the Committee
articles.objective: Explains the legal status of the Committee.
key_points: The Committee is an official organ of the OIC.
It consists of Permanent Representatives of Member States.
Its legal authority comes from Article 5 of the OIC Charter.

articles.title: Functions of the Committee
articles.objective: Defines the responsibilities of the Committee.

functions.name: Coordination
functions.description: Coordinate among Member States, the General Secretariat, and all OIC organs.

functions.name: Implementation Follow-up
functions.description: Assist the General Secretariat in monitoring implementation of CFM resolutions and recommendations.
functions.purpose: Ensure decisions are actually carried out.

functions.name: Expert Advisory Role
functions.description: Serve as an expert body whenever requested by the CFM.

functions.name: Working Groups
functions.description: Recommend creation of temporary (ad hoc) working groups when necessary.

functions.name: Institutional Improvement
functions.description: Recommend ways to improve efficiency and rationalize OIC activities.

functions.name: Additional Tasks
functions.description: Carry out any other responsibilities assigned by the Council of Foreign Ministers.

articles.title: Meetings
articles.objective: Defines how often the Committee meets.

extraordinary_meetings.condition: Whenever necessary according to the Rules of Procedure.

articles.title: Reporting
articles.objective: Defines how Committee decisions are handled.

articles.title: Applicable Rules
articles.objective: Specifies which rules apply when these Rules are silent.
key_points: If an issue is not covered here, the official Rules of Procedure will apply.

articles.title: Amendments
key_points: The Committee may recommend amendments to these Rules.

articles.title: Entry into Force
articles.objective: Defines when these Rules become legally effective.
key_points: The Rules become effective immediately after adoption by the Council of Foreign Ministers.

workflow.step_2: Coordinate with Member States and the General Secretariat.
workflow.step_5: Recommend ad hoc working groups if needed.
workflow.step_7: Submit outcomes to the Council of Foreign Ministers.
workflow.step_8: CFM considers and takes appropriate action.

summary.decision_output: Recommendations and reports for the Council of Foreign Ministers
